rules: High Perception; high Religion, moderate or high skill themed to deity; low AC; high Wis; low Fortitude, high Will; low to moderate HP; low accuracy; high to extreme spell DC. Abilities: Prepared divine spellcasting as a cleric of their level; divine font; domain spells

notes.skills: High Religion; a moderate or high skill themed to the deity.
notes.defense: Low AC; low Fortitude, high Will; low to moderate HP.
